يعتذران (form VIII)
# يَعْتَذِرَانِ (yaʕtaḏirāni) /jaʕ.ta.ði.raː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
# يُعْتَذَرَانِ (yuʕtaḏarāni) /juʕ.ta.ða.raː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
